title: Ulysses quote Aristotle
html_source:
In Troilus and Cressida, set during the Trojan War, Shakespeare has Hector, not Ulysses, quote Aristotle, who was born long afterwards, in Act II, Scene 2:

“…(N)ot much
Unlike young men, whom Aristotle thought
Unfit to hear moral philosophy:”

Of course, there is the fun that Joyce makes his book Ulysses quote Aristotle.
